items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He used to play with the Exaltion. Bass. ! Cris used to like them two fellas.

ctx.x: Yeah. I forget that old man. He used to play with the Exaltion. Bass. ! Cris used to like them two fellas. He'd always get them.
What was his name, the bass player?
